ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region at the peduncle junction is dominated by a dark, contiguous pixel mass. Primary lobes exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds. Extensive low-intensity black mottling and linear streaks are distributed throughout. Thick black pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 85 degrees. The notch depth is significant relative to the vertical pixel height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary. Notable high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (peaks and valleys) across both lobes, with more pronounced jaggedness near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric sweep follows a moderate convex curve from the medial notch towards the distal tips, transitioning to a slight upward flare at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of circular, high-contrast white and dark-centered pixel groupings are localized at the far lateral margins (tips) of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the surface of both lobes. These marks are particularly dense and long on the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) covering approximately 30% of the visible surface area. Localized barnacle scarring clusters on the distal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark linear streak extending from the trailing edge towards the center of the left lobe.
